svg.title: Globo neon de relevos abstratos com certificações cloud
svg.desc: Globo vetorial de partículas verdes e relevos irregulares, com quatro badges em uma fileira à frente: Azure Fundamentals, OCI Foundations Associate, AWS Cloud Practitioner em progresso e Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer em progresso. Fundo transparente.

svg.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Associate
svg.desc: Active OCI Foundations Associate certification badge.

svg.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner — In Progress
svg.desc: AWS Cloud Practitioner certification badge shown as in progress.

svg.title: Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer — In Progress
svg.desc: Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer badge shown as in progress.
